workResult.summary: Executed only Skill 04 Research Analysis after fail-closed admission, deterministic verification of the authoritative Analysis prompt SHA-256, complete reading of all seven required control/editorial/evidence sources, a durable same-date Wake Receipt, repository-granted global-serial execution authority and a verified Worker Claimed event. Consumed only the three completed 2026-08-17 Reading Results and produced exactly three Research Objects. Q-20260817-01 concludes that forward-compatible agent APIs should treat security-significant schema retirement as an explicit fail-closed compatibility exception when silently dropping a removed field would change authorization meaning; this preserves generic unknown-field tolerance without claiming end-to-end authorization safety. Q-20260817-02 concludes that execution-scoped configuration should follow the selected resolved environment, with explicit fallback and precedence, to avoid split-brain policy ownership; Debug redaction is only one observability control and not a confidentiality guarantee. Q-20260817-03 concludes that operational command compaction should be a reversible presentation transform over a richer evidence-bearing transcript, while formal auditability still requires separate durability, provenance, tamper-evidence and external-effect contracts. No article drafting, visualization, Publication Candidate creation or publication was performed.
workResult.summary_zh: 在完成 Fail-closed Admission、权威 Analysis Prompt SHA-256 的确定性核验、全部 7 个 Required Control/Editorial/Evidence Source 的完整读取、同日 Wake Receipt 持久核验、仓库授予的全局串行执行权与 Worker Claimed 核验后，仅执行 Skill 04 Research Analysis。只消费 2026-08-17 当日三份已完成 Reading Result，并恰好形成三份 Research Object。Q-20260817-01 的判断是：当前向兼容 Agent API 中某个退役字段被静默丢弃会改变授权语义时，应把这类具有安全意义的 Schema Retirement 作为显式 Fail-closed Compatibility Exception；这样既保留通用未知字段容忍，也不把该机制夸大为端到端授权安全。Q-20260817-02 的判断是：执行级配置应跟随已选择的 Resolved Environment，并明确 Fallback 与 Precedence，以避免 Split-brain Policy Ownership；Debug Redaction 只是一项可观测性控制，不是保密保证。Q-20260817-03 的判断是：运维命令压缩应是富证据 Transcript 之上的可逆 Presentation Transform；正式审计仍需要独立的 Durability、Provenance、防篡改与 External-effect Contract。未执行文章撰写、可视化、Publication Candidate 创建或发布。

researchObjects.judgment: Security-significant schema retirement should be an explicit fail-closed compatibility exception when silent field loss would change authorization or execution expectations; generic unknown-field tolerance may remain, but this pattern is not a substitute for end-to-end authorization controls.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 当静默丢失字段会改变授权或执行预期时，具有安全意义的 Schema Retirement 应成为显式 Fail-closed Compatibility Exception；通用未知字段容忍可以保留，但这一模式不能替代端到端授权控制。

researchObjects.judgment: Execution-scoped policy should follow the resolved environment that owns the work, with explicit fallback, merge precedence and preferably a stable policy identity/fingerprint for durable resume; redaction does not imply complete secret isolation.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 执行级 Policy 应跟随实际拥有工作的 Resolved Environment，并明确 Fallback、Merge Precedence；对 Durable Resume 最好再提供稳定的 Policy Identity/Fingerprint；Redaction 不等于完整 Secret Isolation。

researchObjects.judgment: Operational compaction should remain a view-layer transformation over recoverable execution evidence, with failures and interaction boundaries resistant to compaction; a retained transcript supports inspection but is not automatically an immutable audit or external-effect ledger.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 运维压缩应保持为可恢复执行证据之上的 View-layer Transformation，并让失败与交互边界避免被压缩；保留 Transcript 可以支持检查，但不会自动成为不可变 Audit 或 External-effect Ledger。
